note: [20261022 QAD student collect, variant v3m: {'effort': 'medium'}] B200 TITO collection with run_arc2_seq (2026-10-14): kaggle-l4-seq-c150k-wrap.json's harness unchanged -- xhigh, prompts v3, window 150,000 / compact 100,000, s0 and s2 at 200,000 output tokens (s2: --second-budget defaults to the config's), refiners at 100,000 (--refine-budget defaults to half), wrap-up +32,000 (refiners +16,000: --refine-wrapup defaults to half), no midpoint reminder, max_sessions 3, task wall 21,600 s, max_failures 9 -- moved to the B200 way of running it, for the official Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 + DFlash sglang server started with --session-replay --session-ledger-dir <dir> --session-ledger-all (ids only: no routing, no logprobs). Differences from the Kaggle config, key by key: (1) tito {required: true}: run_arc2_seq checks /get_server_info (session_replay, session_ledger_dir) and /session_ledger/status before the first episode and writes tito_manifest.json at the end (also after SIGTERM / SIGINT and at a deadline); it then requires --pool-label <pool>, recorded in the manifest's meta. driver_config already had features.sglang_session_release "true" (codex patch 0002: requests carry session_id = <thread>:<window>), which tito requires. (2) fence none (was posix: root, one uid per task) as on node1: --driver-bin ~/work/codex-0.154.0-p7/arc2-jail/bin/codex, the bwrap wrapper that hides $HOME, /nfs and /tmp from codex (not in the repo; see node1-tito-collect-jail.json and the seq-int3 collection config); network_namespace stays false. (3) concurrency stays null (the same key as Kaggle, where kaggle_run passes it; the seq-int3 collection config has 64 for one TP1 card): give --concurrency 128 x the number of TP2 replicas (128 sessions each; the server's --max-running-requests must allow that per replica) and, for a DP server, --dp-size so each episode goes to the least busy DP. (4) process_data_max 8G, game_memory_max 10G, uid_base 33000, heartbeat_seconds 300 as in the seq-int3 collection config (Kaggle: 6G / 8G / 31000 / 60; game_memory_max and uid_base only matter under fence posix). Kept from Kaggle although the seq-int3 collection config differs: task_wall_seconds 21,600 (node1 14,400: a collection wants the token budget, not the wall, to end an episode), max_failures 9 (node1 3: a long collection should not be cancelled by a few tracebacks), midpoint_reminder_tokens null and wrapup_tokens 32,000 (node1: 65,000 reminder, no wrap-up). Server: CTXLEN should be the native 262144, not 150000 -- with images sglang does not clamp max_output_tokens and the proxy's cap (up to 232,000) must fit next to the prompt (the seq-int3 collection config's note).
